_comment: What a built copy of this app knows about the licence server before it is
ever run. Neither value is a secret: the public key is the verifying half
of the signing pair, and the URL is a public endpoint. The private key
lives only in admin-saas, and the session secret is generated per install.
Fill these in, then build. A release build refuses to start if they are
empty, because an installer that cannot reach its licence server is one
that cannot be set up, and finding that out on someone else's computer is
Generate the pair with: node admin-saas/scripts/gen-license-keys.js
